notes:
Account snapshot: FluxForge builds an IDE-integrated copilot product (VS Code/JetBrains) aimed at mid-market developer teams. Primary differentiator is low-latency streaming completions + continuous repo indexing. They run both interactive completions and large nightly background jobs that refresh embeddings for customers' monorepos.

Key asks / requirements:
- IDE & streaming: sub-50ms token tail latency for in-editor streaming, cold-start <150ms; need stable model/version pinning to avoid regressions in code quality.
- Background throughput: nightly embedding refresh across ~4,800 repos (approx 10M files/segments total) — target: finish window by 04:00 UTC, sustained embedding throughput ~30k docs/hr during batch window.
- Indexing pipeline: batching aggressiveness (64-128), automatic retry/backpressure, and ability to run on dedicated pools for predictability.
- Cost sensitivity: want recommendations for quantized model variants (q4/q5) and batching configs that preserve completion quality while cutting token cost >=45%.
- Security/compliance: strict SSO/SAML, KMS for key management, audit logs retention 1y+, data residency (US + EU), optional on-prem connector for very sensitive customers.
